paraphrase: On any existing arena, relative maximalist coverage entails every restricted coverage and free semantics; factivity and coherence make InstanceMaker sound; a world-immanent uniform maker plus actual self-access yields an actual necessary individual; maximalism of a necessary fact yields local makers. Finite truthmakers satisfies maximalism and maker necessitation but has no uniform maker or necessary being; the restricted profile has actual positive witness and a weaker frozen absence conjunct (strict noncoverage is separately certified by TRUTHMAKER-RESTRICTED-SEPARATION). Free semantics admits both noMaking and a nonempty local relation. fixedBearer has maximalist uniform making and a necessary noncausing individual; switchingFixedMaking has a necessary individual and maximalism but no uniform maker of the existential fact. lawGround has a uniform fact-reason yet no world-immanent uniform individual maker. All finite policies are fragment-relative and analyst stipulated.
